verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's own REST API lets you retrieve session history and list registered clients. Its documented open-source Python module can export session data to the terminal or to CSV, an open format. This is a first-party export path, but it covers only session and client data and requires API scripting; nothing documents a complete account export or a deletion and offboarding flow. Missing for 10: export of all data (address books, settings, users/roles), a one-click full-account export, documented account deletion/offboarding, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
